hotels.title: Historic Strasbourg MGallery Elegance in a Storybook Alsatian Setting
hotels.description: Step into Strasbourg’s storied past at this five-star retreat set within a meticulously restored 16th-century coaching inn in the heart of La Petite France. Timber-framed facades, cobbled courtyards and period details place you moments from the Ill River, the covered bridges and the soaring Gothic spire of Strasbourg Cathedral. Mornings begin with Alsatian pastries before strolls to Maison Kammerzell for regional specialities or to Place Kléber’s elegant boutiques. Back at the hotel, individually styled rooms pair heritage character with refined contemporary touches, and the intimate bar pours local wines in a vaulted setting
